sloka: ते गतिज्ञा गतिम् गत्वा पृथिव्याम् सर्व वानराः ।आनयंतु हरीन् सर्वान् त्वरिताः शासनान् मम ॥४-३७-१५॥
transliteration: te gatijñā gatim gatvā pṛthivyām sarva vānarāḥ ।ānayaṁtu harīn sarvān tvaritāḥ śāsanān mama ॥4-37-15॥

translations.english: Let the monkeys who know the regions, knowing their routes, quickly bring at my command all the monkeys upon the earth.
